summary: Converts input edges into tubes and optionally points into spheres, producing renderable wireframe, pipe, and structural geometry.

key_params.name: group
key_params.note: Restrict wire conversion to selected geometry

key_params.name: radius
key_params.note: Tube radius for each converted edge

key_params.name: corners
key_params.note: Add spherical rounded corners at point locations

key_params.name: caps
key_params.note: Add end caps to generated wire geometry

key_params.name: remove
key_params.note: Remove original polygons and keep only generated wires

key_params.name: fast
key_params.note: Use faster wire calculation with lower accuracy

common_gotchas: Wireframe SOP generates real tube and sphere geometry, so dense meshes can become very heavy.
Round Corners add spheres at points and can multiply polygon count quickly.
Remove Polygons is needed when the desired output is only the tube structure.
Fast Wire trades accuracy for speed; avoid it when wires must meet cleanly at complex corners.
key_concepts: Wireframe SOP converts edges into tube geometry and can convert points into spheres at rounded corners.
Wire Radius controls the generated wire thickness.
Round Corners, End Caps, and Remove Polygons decide whether output is pipe-like, capped, and wire-only.
Fast Wire improves speed at the expense of join accuracy.
